scope: Every chart-module public inventory entry plus chart enums, chart format, chart-bearing shapes and inherited graph members. Flowchart/autoshape decorative names and organization-chart placeholders are unrelated and excluded. Shared returned text/format types retain obligations in public-api-map.json; this bounded receipt is not a whole-public-API certificate.
notice: Research/provenance only. See upstream-license-notice.txt and public-api-map-notice.txt.

languageSecurityMappings.names: Retain neutral snake_case model spellings. Inventory operation JSON is independently camelCase; no blanket alias layer.
languageSecurityMappings.properties: Source property means direct JS access/assignment. Source creating getters remain future owner-bound mutations. Read-only inspection never invokes or emulates their creation side effects.
languageSecurityMappings.collections: Future model .length and Symbol.iterator; checked at(index). Chart points reject negative indices; plots and chart-data support slices with exclusive end and nonzero integer step; other collections have only inventoried semantics. Returned category labels map to .label/toString(), not a JS String subclass.
languageSecurityMappings.builders: CategoryChartData/XyChartData/BubbleChartData and ChartData constructors remain synchronous in-memory builders. add_chart/insert_chart/replace_data remain synchronous after admitted input, returning GraphicFrame for insertion. No workbook computation or external refresh.
languageSecurityMappings.numbers: Source enums remain neutral typed symbols with exact values and immutable XML conversion metadata. Dates use explicit UTC Date and recorded workbook date system. Cached numeric lexical values are not evaluated formulas.
languageSecurityMappings.absence: Distinguish absent/inherited null, zero, false and empty string. Inventory raw absence must not claim effective model/theme defaults.
languageSecurityMappings.ownership: Model graph is live and owner-bound; inspection snapshots do not implement identity, invalidation or cross-document assignment. XML/part members remain public security-mapped obligations with bounded qualified nodes/bytes/relations, not arbitrary XPath/host access.
languageSecurityMappings.io: Always-async explicit byte/VFS admission. No implicit host paths, network fetch, native runtime, embedded object activation or external workbook refresh. External relationship target is inert metadata.
languageSecurityMappings.errors: Future model ValueError invalid-value, TypeError invalid-type, IndexError index-out-of-range, KeyError missing-key, PropertyAccessError property-unavailable/read-only-property and InvalidHandleError invalid-handle retain J08. Inventory uses existing OfficeError contracts. CLI success 0, validation/unsupported/selection 1, usage/schema 2, I/O 3, limits 4, cancellation 130.
languageSecurityMappings.operationDates: Direct operation ChartData uses homogeneous UTC-Z strings rather than live Date instances; date-looking strings are interpreted as UTC dates with time-of-day discarded. The future live model Date mapping remains outstanding, not security-exempt.
languageSecurityMappings.prototypeSafety: Direct data/options must be plain own data properties; accessor and prototype-bearing objects are rejected before use. Dense bounded arrays reject holes, undefined and nonfinite numeric values.

documentationDrift.historicalStatus: Audits and target register describe checkpoints; their not-implemented and proposed routes do not determine current bounded operation availability. This receipt never upgrades full model status.
documentationDrift.insertionReturn: Incorrect add_chart return annotation resolves to GraphicFrame, not Chart; retained as a future model obligation.
documentationDrift.collections: Do not hide _BaseAxis/_BaseSeries and other underscored returned interfaces. Negative positions and slicing follow per-collection mappings rather than native Array defaults.
documentationDrift.creatingGetters: Chart/axis title and text/font/data-label access can create XML; read-only inspection reports existing structure without creating these objects.
documentationDrift.authority: Formulas describe linked source data; cache values may be stale. Inventory does not claim calculation or workbook/cache agreement.
documentationDrift.creation: The proposed spec accepts 29 symbols; the requested family slice contains 19. The slice is not full F37/F38/public-model completion.
documentationDrift.historicalUsage: chart-inventory-usage.md describes the earlier read-only inventory operation. Editing availability is recorded separately in chart-editing-usage.md and executable capabilities; historical text must not disable or overstate newer commands.
